# Dataset Card — Forecasting Portfolio & History

**Generated by:** `capstone/lib/onelp_eval/portfolio.py` (deterministic)

## Reference portfolio (16 funds)

- **7 real seeded funds** — the Huergo Family Office demo account
  (`prisma/seed-huergo.ts`): exact commitment / paid-in / NAV / IRR / TVPI / DPI for
  Kaszek IV, NXTP III, Dragoneer III, Riverwood IV, Monashees VII, Globant SPV,
  SoftBank LatAm II.
- **9 institutional extensions** — CVC VIII, Ares Europe VI, Apollo IX, Blackstone RE X,
  Brookfield Infra V, Permira VIII, HPS Mezzanine IV, KKR RE Europe II, Insight XII —
  added to cover all five correlation asset classes (PE buyout, real estate, private
  credit, growth, infrastructure/VC) at scale.

Totals: **$143M committed, $39M unfunded, 6 asset classes.**

## Quarterly cash-flow history

Each fund's quarterly call/distribution series is generated by a documented
data-generating process (`generate_history`):

- per-quarter LEVELS = the fund's age-appropriate deployment/distribution rate (the
  exact bands in `historical.ts:290-345`) applied to unfunded / NAV — i.e. the *same*
  rate model the engine consumes;
- mild drift (deployment fades, distributions build as the book matures);
- lognormal lumpiness (~16% on calls, ~20% on distributions).

The engine never sees the DGP — only the truncated history compressed to the
`FundHistoricalData` stats the production `aggregateFundCashFlows` would compute — so the
held-out backtest is a fair test of engine calibration.

## Why not live data

Live pilot-client cash flows are confidential and out of scope for a shipped deliverable.
The portfolio is a calibrated stand-in: real demo-account funds plus realistic
institutional extensions, with cash-flow history from an engine-agnostic process.
